subject.title: [Bug]: active-memory embedded run cannot resolve Lossless Claw lcm_* tools despite runtime plugin inspect showing them registered

question: Should the fix for this issue broaden plugin runtime probing when a manifest pre-filter misses, or preserve manifest-first explicit tool ownership and target the Lossless embedded-run gap narrowly?
rationale: The issue is a documented bug, but the current open fix candidate affects the plugin tool authorization boundary; automation should not choose that security/product tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require a narrow manifest-first fix
options.body: Keep explicit tool allowlists tied to declared/owned tools and fix the embedded Lossless registry or config snapshot path with live proof.

options.title: Accept broader runtime probing
options.body: Allow the resolver to probe all enabled tool-contract plugins on zero manifest matches, accepting the larger tool-surface behavior as intentional.

options.title: Pause for live repro only
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a current-main Lossless run before deciding whether the linked PR or a replacement is needed.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow manifest-first fix
recommendation.body: Keep explicit tool allowlists tied to declared/owned tools and fix the embedded Lossless registry or config snapshot path with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner introduced the active-memory custom tools and Lossless documentation that define the expected behavior.
